materialization.rule: For each integer n in [1,83], R32P{n:04d} has exactly one primary owner R32Z{n:04d}.
materialization.payload_rule: Compression payload is the parse unit normalized_content without semantic rewrite.
materialization.standing_rule: Compression standing equals parse standing exactly.
materialization.path_blob_rule: Compression provenance inherits parse path and blob exactly.

note: Fourteen parse units retain disposition UNRESOLVED as payload standing/content, but still map directly to explicit compression items; unresolved source standing is not a projection failure.
